subject: O Level E-Math
title: Graph of a quadratic
question:
(a) Complete the table of values for y = x² − 2x − 3 for −2 ≤ x ≤ 4.
(b) On the grid, draw the graph of y = x² − 2x − 3.
(c) Use your graph to solve x² − 2x − 3 = 0.
(d) Write down the coordinates of the minimum point.

scene: The curve is calculated by the renderer from the equation.
First try: the marked points had to be scaled by hand to match the graph, which is easy to get wrong.
Second try: the renderer now accepts points in graph units and scales them itself. The axis numbers also got a white background so grid lines do not run through them.
tikz: pgfplots handles the grid, ticks and curve.
First try: the equation label was cut off at the edge of the graph.
Second try: moved the label to the top of the graph.
svg: A parabola can be drawn as a single curve, so the whole graph line is one short path.
First try: the equation label sat on top of the curve.
Second try: moved the label to the top of the grid.
